summary: All press settings (shut height and stroke for blanking, piercing, Forming I and II) are present on the right machines, but no blanking, piercing or forming dimension is given; only 'as per control plan'. The chamfer 5x45° and R3 are applied after shearing instead of checked after blanking, the header says UNIT-3 with a suffixed part number, and the RH part number drops the N. It adds a 150 T shearing machine, min/max shut heights, a form reference and die-pad/pin tool items.
